attribution.scope: Selected mechanisms and failure controls are separate from population statistics. No population descendant-success, human-user or economic-funder estimate.

selected_cases.label: Delegated claim
selected_cases.mechanism: Explicit Delegate → claim.sweat.claim → token.sweat.ft_transfer → claim callback; no verified human/operator or revenue attribution.

submission.identity_basis: Exact transaction-outcome block hash and saved canonical successor prev_hash; heights are not assumed consecutive

selected_cases.label: Accepted transfer-call
selected_cases.mechanism: wrap.near.ft_transfer_call → Ref ft_on_transfer → resolver, empty msg; consistent with funding/deposit, no swap/output-asset evidence or independently verified internal credit.

selected_cases.label: Failed execution controls
selected_cases.mechanism: 18 preselected failed transactions; each returned graph has one failure and two successful receipts. Seventeen sampled slippage errors and one insufficient-deposit error; not population error frequencies.

selected_cases.label: Delegated jar deposit
selected_cases.mechanism: Explicit Delegate from jars-oracle.sweat to token.sweat.ft_transfer_call targeting v2.jars.sweat. The receiver logs a deposit and the resolver accepts the full token amount; apply_booster rejects the beneficiary despite successful receipt outcomes. Airdrop is the payload type, not verified human adoption, economic purpose, revenue or native supply destruction.

observed_behavior.application_qualification: All returned receipt outcomes succeed, but the apply_booster event rejects the beneficiary. A deposit is recorded; not every requested application effect is established as successful. Airdrop is the payload type, not independently verified economic purpose.
observed_behavior.units_qualification: Raw token base units; no metadata request or decimal conversion

deliverables.completed: Eight-week observational comparison; one protocol-validated 23-epoch reward week; exact weekly endpoints; 144 inclusion-timed header blocks.
deliverables.criterion: Eight weekly identities with independent issuance, actual burn and verified adjustments, canonical coverage and exact arithmetic.
deliverables.gap: Seven other reward weeks, complete inclusion-timed debits, gross burn/subsidies and full-window canonical coverage. Implied debit is not independent burn.
deliverables.investment_conclusion_affected: Full-window net issuance, independently verified burn and fee-offset inflation cannot be estimated from implied debit or the sampled prefix.
deliverables.saved_work: Reproduce reward maps, protocol checks, endpoints and overlapping debit scopes; enumerate missing canonical coverage without extrapolating it.
deliverables.source_dependency: Lossless retained canonical headers/chunks with predecessor links and inclusion-timed net debits; seven other reward-week endpoint/epoch/configuration captures. Gross burn/subsidy splitting needs retained runtime statistics not established as public API fields.

deliverables.completed: Three-wallet native flows, six endpoint states, eight weekly flow observations, internal-leg cancellation, closed withdrawal trace and one known owner–asset balance reconciliation (result 103).
deliverables.criterion: Historically attributed accounts/assets, eight-week reconciled opening/closing balances and classified fees, principal, settlements, refunds and verified purchases.
deliverables.gap: Complete token/internal-asset coverage, historical roles, fee origin, purchase settlement and balance adjustments. The 1cs difference stays unallocated.
deliverables.investment_conclusion_affected: Attributable revenue yield, verified buyback spend, purchased holdings and holder benefit cannot be inferred from wallet inflows or one internal stock decrease.
deliverables.saved_work: Reproduce native and known internal-asset stocks/flows separately, with exact identities and unavailable economic classifications. One asset reconciliation is not complete flow history. No residual-driven collection.
deliverables.source_dependency: Retained historical NEP-141/NEP-245 events indexed by owner/recipient; historical internal-account associations, role/policy/fee configuration and successful exchange settlement. Native-counterparty SQL 45 cannot discover all assets; no accessible complete index is established.

deliverables.completed: Four activity cohorts; nine complete checkpoints; three incomplete checkpoints remain null; three exact-return initial-receipt pilots and two overlapping repeated-checkpoint subsets.
deliverables.criterion: Several starting-week activity cohorts, exact +1/+4/+8 checkpoints wherever follow-up is complete, transaction contribution, concentration and scoped outcomes/spending.
deliverables.gap: No continuous-week or human retention claim, no execution result for other checkpoints, no descendant census, six-day lookup tails and aggregate/FLOAT source limits.
deliverables.investment_conclusion_affected: Persistent signing-account use is supported in scope; broad human retention, execution across every cohort and complete-chain economic demand remain unestablished.
deliverables.saved_work: Reproduce denominators, overlap, returner contribution/concentration and scoped execution-date spending; keep the three incomplete follow-ups unavailable.
deliverables.source_dependency: Retained transaction-to-initial-receipt/outcome exports for other complete checkpoints, longer execution tails and later follow-up weeks. Saved aggregates cannot recover missing account-level links or descendant outcomes.
deliverables.status: Cohort layer validated; execution coverage partial

deliverables.completed: Selected Sweat claim and delegated jar deposit (with booster rejection), accepted wx transfer-call, 18 failed tinykoala controls, canonical submission dates and saved population coverage table.
deliverables.criterion: Reproducible population attribution and descendant coverage with historical roles, submitter/inner actor distinctions and no join duplication.
deliverables.gap: Population-wide descendant success, independent actor/funder/ownership mapping and internal exchange credit or swap evidence. Selected cases are not representative.
deliverables.investment_conclusion_affected: Independent-user breadth, economic payer identity and population downstream settlement/success cannot be inferred from signer rankings or selected examples.
deliverables.saved_work: Revalidate returned DAGs, callbacks, exact charges and selection denominators alongside population signer/receiver statistics; keep selected cases separate.
deliverables.source_dependency: Population-linked delegated identities, historical actor/funder roles and a declared sampling frame with descendant receipt outcomes. Bounded RPC traces establish selected mechanisms, not a population census.

deliverables.completed: Reviewed Decimal model, zero-capture and allocation guards, horizon scaling, 27 sensitivity cases and reproducible hypothetical outputs.
deliverables.criterion: Editable assumptions, units/formulas, disjoint revenue/destruction/custody outputs, thresholds, sensitivity and measurable revision conditions.
deliverables.gap: Measured fee capture, purchases, destruction and full supply components remain unavailable; scenarios do not establish fair value or expected returns.
deliverables.investment_conclusion_affected: Conditional activity/capture hurdles are calculable; fair value, expected returns and observed economic or investment break-even are unsupported.
deliverables.saved_work: Reproduce formulas, sensitivity, units, allocation constraints and field-level provenance; distinguish the dated reward baseline from illustrative and unavailable inputs.
deliverables.source_dependency: Historically attributed fee-bearing activity/capture, independently verified purchases/destruction and complete supply components from deliverables 1–2; actor attribution constrains demand interpretation.

model_input_provenance.qualification: Native and internal asset stocks are context, not fee-bearing USD activity, revenue, purchases or supply destruction. The reward-only target excludes independently unavailable subsidies; scenario outputs are not expected returns.

native_ledger.scope: Native actions and six endpoint account states; not complete token/internal-asset coverage, weekly stock reconciliation or independently attributed revenue/buybacks.

returner_execution_bounds.display_rounding: Lower percentages rounded down and upper percentages up to two decimals using integer division. Exact counts and rational numerators/denominators are authoritative. Zero outside denominator has no percentage.

formula.T: transactions from this population's own ten leading returners

limitations: Proves minimum successful initial receipts beyond each population's own ten leading signers within observed coverage, not measured account-level success rates, independent humans, revenue or complete-chain settlement.
Cohorts overlap and use different submission weeks; never sum their bounds or interpret differences causally.

Complete membership and receipt lists are not exported. Alignment uses reviewed, hashed SQL definitions and validated aggregate controls; no independent row-level set-equality or ingestion-completeness proof is available.
Six-day initial-execution tails and observed receipt-owner uniqueness windows remain unchanged. Spending is not allocated outside the top ten by these counts.
